alt: Mirza and Farah compare one-step errors across periods without feeding predictions back.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 2 are canonical identity authorities in this order: commander-mirza, dr-farah. Reference 3 is the room authority; reference 4 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 2 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Commander Mirza: dark-skinned mature woman, close-cropped dark hair with gray temples, gold-trim dark command uniform, round chest badge and small hoop earrings. Dr. Farah: medium-brown skin, dark tied hair, gray lab coat, earrings and translucent green AR lens over her left eye.
Specific action and staging: Farah has turned from her console toward Commander Mirza, who leans in to question the comparison. Keep an engaged, cautious conversation. Farah rests one hand at the keyboard and the other on the bench; Mirza braces one hand on the rail and holds a closed logbook against her side. Large upright shared display close behind the controls uses formerly empty upper space.
Exact visible display content: Title: "Compare the same horizon". Two side-by-side panels "Earlier period" and "Later period", both with "Observed history" to "One-step prediction". Beneath both: "No prediction feedback". Footer "Rising error prompts investigation" and small but readable qualifier "Cause unresolved". No fabricated error numbers.
